Upgrading PySpark​

Upgrading from PySpark 3.5 to 4.0​

  • In Spark 4.0, DataFrame.to_koalas has been removed from the pandas API on Spark. Use DataFrame.pandas_api instead.
  • In Spark 4.0, DataFrame.append has been removed from the pandas API on Spark. Use ps.concat instead.

Upgrading from PySpark 3.4 to 3.5​

  • In Spark 3.5, old_thing_function was removed.

Upgrading from PySpark 4.0 to 4.1​

  • In Spark 4.1, future_removed_function was removed.
